item.name: 003 默认过滤与分页全量基准

exec: const b=pm.response.json();pm.test('HTTP200与业务200',()=>{pm.expect(pm.response.code).eq(200);pm.expect(b.code).eq(200);});pm.test("38个唯一审核通过企业在招岗位",()=>{pm.expect(b.data.total).eq(38);pm.expect(b.data.items).lengthOf(38);pm.expect(new Set(b.data.items.map(x=>x.id)).size).eq(38);pm.expect(b.data.items.every(x=>x.status===0&&[201,204].includes(x.companyId))).eq(true);pm.expect(b.data.items.some(x=>[1013,1014,1015,1016,1017].includes(x.id))).eq(false);pm.expect(b.data.items[0].id).eq(2002);});pm.collectionVariables.set('jbAll',JSON.stringify(b.data));

const b=pm.response.json();pm.test('HTTP200与业务200',()=>{pm.expect(pm.response.code).eq(200);pm.expect(b.code).eq(200);});pm.test("新增12字段取自数据库",()=>{const x=b.data.items.find(x=>x.id===1001);pm.expect(x.companyId).eq(201);pm.expect(x.companyName).eq('已审核回归企业');pm.expect(x.companyLogo).eq('https://example.invalid/job-card-logo.png');pm.expect(x.summary).eq('岗位卡片简介');pm.expect(x.benefits).eq('弹性工作、带薪年假');pm.expect(x.requiredSkills).eq('Java');pm.expect(x.preferredSkills).eq('Docker');pm.expect(x.directionCode).eq('BACKEND');pm.expect(x.requiredAbilitiesSource).eq('LEGACY_TEXT');pm.expect(x.requiredAbilitiesVersion).eq(0);pm.expect(x.publishedAt).eq('2026-10-01T10:00:00');pm.expect(x.deadline).eq('2026-12-31');pm.expect(x).include.all.keys('id','title','category','team','employment','status','city','experience','education','salaryMin','salaryMax','salaryUnit','negotiable','updateTime');});pm.test("空值与复杂技能保持",()=>{pm.expect(b.data.items.find(x=>x.id===2001).companyLogo).eq(null);pm.expect(b.data.items.find(x=>x.id===1020).publishedAt).eq(null);pm.expect(b.data.items.find(x=>x.id===1020).category).eq(null);pm.expect(b.data.items.find(x=>x.id===1005).requiredSkills).eq(null);pm.expect(b.data.items.find(x=>x.id===1007).requiredSkills).eq('跨部门沟通');pm.expect(b.data.items.find(x=>x.id===1022).requiredAbilitiesVersion).eq(7);});

const b=pm.response.json();pm.test('HTTP200与业务200',()=>{pm.expect(pm.response.code).eq(200);pm.expect(b.code).eq(200);});pm.test("失败后全部业务字段未变",()=>{pm.expect(b.data).deep.eq(JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('jbAll')))});

const b=pm.response.json();pm.test('HTTP200与业务200',()=>{pm.expect(pm.response.code).eq(200);pm.expect(b.code).eq(200);});pm.test("全局排序而不是页内排序",()=>{const source=JSON.parse(pm.collectionVariables.get('jbAll')).items;const eligible=x=>x.salaryUnit==='MONTH'&&x.negotiable===false&&Number.isInteger(x.salaryMin)&&x.salaryMin>0&&Number.isInteger(x.salaryMax)&&x.salaryMax>=x.salaryMin;const time=(a,b)=>b.updateTime.localeCompare(a.updateTime)||b.id-a.id;const expected=[...source].sort((a,b)=>Number(eligible(b))-Number(eligible(a))||(eligible(a)?b.salaryMax-a.salaryMax:0)||time(a,b));pm.expect(b.data.total).eq(38);pm.expect(b.data.items).deep.eq(expected);pm.expect(b.data.items.slice(0,5).map(x=>x.id)).deep.eq([1028,1027,2001,2002,2003]);});pm.test("年薪日薪面议和异常范围全部置后",()=>{let tail=false;for(const x of b.data.items){const eligible=x.salaryUnit==='MONTH'&&x.negotiable===false&&Number.isInteger(x.salaryMin)&&x.salaryMin>0&&Number.isInteger(x.salaryMax)&&x.salaryMax>=x.salaryMin;if(!eligible)tail=true;else pm.expect(tail).eq(false);}const ids=b.data.items.filter(x=>!(x.salaryUnit==='MONTH'&&x.negotiable===false&&Number.isInteger(x.salaryMin)&&x.salaryMin>0&&Number.isInteger(x.salaryMax)&&x.salaryMax>=x.salaryMin)).map(x=>x.id);pm.expect(ids).include.members([1003,1004,1023,1024,1025,2004,2005,2006,2007,2008,2009,2010,2011,2012,2013]);});pm.collectionVariables.set('jbSalary',JSON.stringify(b.data));
